mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises (3-month change > 0.1%).

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS have 3-month changes < 0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing cycle that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS 1mo change < 0
failure_condition: In periods of CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines (1mo change < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises (3-month change > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 2000 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 2000, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate profit expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both INDPRO and GDPC1 have 3-month changes < 0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises (3-month change > 0).
